notes.policy: Identity is the security backbone: every deploy is manual, one server at a time, with the 084 collation migration applied per-server DB BEFORE the swap.

notes.helpers: Server-side helper scripts (activate-release etc.) managed per host
notes.appsettings: Machine-specific + Production configuration kept on the server (secrets arrive via /etc/sufficit/identity/vault-secrets.env)
notes.certificates: Token signing/encryption PFX plus the retained previous certificate

testing.note: Nginx terminates TLS per server and proxies to the unix socket /run/sufficit-identity/identity.sock (port 26501).
